source: Math grade 3, chapter 1, lesson «ماشین‌های ورودی ـ خروجی» (book pp. 13–15). Card v1.0 (source docx: machine 2→4, 3→6, 4→?; wrong answer = soft stop / warning lamp; IO-M01 rule from one example, IO-M02 attends to gear shape, IO-M03 no relation from two examples; H1 compare the two examples, H2 a line linking the examples, H3 a visual ×2 on one example; mastery ×2 → +3 → ×3 + a new rule without H3). Textbook p.13: a +5 machine and «if 15 came out, what went in?» (the reverse question = PRA); p.14 find inputs from outputs. Quest Q02: the workshop parts machine forgot its rule; the clock tower needs parts. World state WS_IO_MACHINE_ON; the water-machine Transfer is later (outside the VS).

stages.objective_fa: ماشین قاعده‌اش را فراموش کرده. چرخ‌دندهٔ درست را بگذار و اهرم را بکش.
stages.answer_objective_fa: حالا بگو: ماشین با عدد ۴ چه می‌سازد؟

hints.animation: LUMI flies from the first memory row to the second and back; both rows pulse together (card H1: «دو نمونه را با هم مقایسه کن»)
a glowing line links the two examples and each number becomes dot groups: ×n = the input repeated n times, +n = the input plus n extra dots in another colour (card H2: line linking the examples)
a ghost of the correct rule plaque appears on the first row's arrow (card H3: a visual ×۲ on one example)

stages.source_note: card v1.0 puzzle verbatim: 2→4, 3→6, 4→? = 8. Gears: +۲ fits only the first example (IO-M01), ×۳ fits none (IO-M03); answer option ۷ = the card's wrong 4→7, ۶ = the +۲ single-example rule applied

stages.source_note: textbook p.13 activity: «اگر عدد ۱۵ از ماشین خارج شده باشد، چه عددی وارد آن شده است؟» — the reverse question with a +n machine. Gears: ×۴ fits only 1→4 (IO-M01), +۴ fits none (IO-M03); option ۱۳ = rule applied forward (IO-M04), ۶ = off by one

misconceptions.description: Picks a rule that explains only one example (e.g. +2 because 2→4) and does not check it against the second (card v1.0).
Picks a rule that explains neither example: no relation extracted from the two examples (card v1.0, e.g. the card's 4→7).

In the reverse question applies the rule forward to the output (10 + 3 = 13) instead of undoing it. Team addition from textbook p.13 (not in the source card list): logged for the parent report, never shown as an error message.

design_mitigations.note: card v1.0 IO-M02 (looks at the gear shape): all rule gears have the same size, colour and teeth; only the plaque differs, so shape can never carry the answer. Not classified at runtime.

mastery.note: card v1.0: ×2 → +3 → ×3 + a new rule without H3 → level 4 in the TRA stage when max hint ≤ 2. Level 5 needs the water-machine Transfer (later quest, plan 06 §9).

audio.on_process: SFX_GEAR_ROTATE loop while a token is inside
audio.on_wrong: SFX_MACHINE_FAIL_SOFT (hiccup + steam puff, amber lamp, no punishment)
